title: Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs
main_claim: Every projective generalized lc Q-pair (X,B+M) over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero has a minimal model if K+B+M is pseudo-effective, and a Mori fibre space otherwise, with the nef b-divisor kept fixed. The route: a local phase theorem for cyclic Gorenstein klt germs gives termination of the K_X-MMP with scaling for smooth projective X with pseudo-effective K_X. That gives a relative weak Zariski decomposition, Tsakanikas–Xie then supply generalized lc existence, and the result descends to the stated field.

issues.location: Sec 2, Prop 2.2 / Sec 1 discussion of Cor 1.2
issues.description: Not a gap in the paper. The whole result rests on the local phase theorem (Thm 2.1), and through it on the uniform Lifting/Mixing and bounded-fibre theorems (Secs 9-12). Proving termination of smooth canonical MMP with scaling in every dimension would resolve a major open problem, so everything hinges on those deep uniform local statements, which this audit did not verify line by line.
issues.evidence: Global deduction checked in detail: lambda_i->0 via BCHM finiteness of ample models; DEL uniform multiplier squeeze (glob:uniform-squeeze) giving Delta_i(u)<=A_X(u)/s; countability of finite limits via the limit valuation u_infty; index-one cover with unique fixed point; E_i(u_i)=w'_i(theta_i/eta^0) congruence giving the countable/uncountable contradiction; late-flip vanishing coefficient A_i-1-(m-1)Delta_i>-1. I checked that vanishing criterion by hand on the 4-fold toric flip P^2 with normal bundle O(-1)^2: it predicts vanishing exactly for m<=2, matching the formal-functions computation H^2(P^2,O(j-m)). Fujino effective base point freeness plus Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity then contradicts K-negativity on the flipping curve.

coverage: Read carefully: Sec 0-2 (all of the global deduction: termination, relative WZD by double cover, Tsakanikas–Xie transfer, discrepancy monotonicity, rho(Y/T)=1, field descent); Sec 3 (cone and regrading, alpha estimates, complement); Sec 4 (graph discrepancy bound, single-adjoint-section lemma, jet/volume counting, tier induction for h·prod d_j<=C); Sec 5 (window lemma, lattice index bound, optimization); Sec 7 (counting lemmas, rounding segment, final congruence with ell=lcm(1..D_fin), which I checked algebraically); Sec 8 (integral barrier, Birkar effective-birationality hypotheses, strict ceiling inequality, mixing). Skimmed Sec 6 (char-p log Cartier selection) without verifying it. Not read: Secs 9-12 (tower reduction, bounded presentations, traits, lc incidence) and the proof of Lifting and Mixing.
